transcript.text: Let me search the SailPoint MCP tools for audit/search-related capabilities.

Here's how to query audit/activity events from ISC.

## Endpoint

**`POST /v3/search`** — ISC's unified search API. Audit/activity events live in the `events` index.

## Auth

1. Create a PAT (max 10 per user) in the ISC UI to get a `client_id`/`client_secret`.
2. Exchange them for a bearer token — credentials go in the **POST body**, never a query string:

```http
POST https://{tenant}.api.identitynow.com/oauth/token
Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded

grant_type=client_credentials&client_id=YOUR_ID&client_secret=YOUR_SECRET
```

3. Use the returned `access_token` as `Authorization: Bearer <token>` on every request.

**Required scope:** `sp:search:read`

---

## Querying audit events — last 24 hours, filtered by type

```http
POST https://{tenant}.api.identitynow.com/v3/search?limit=250&count=true
Authorization: Bearer <token>
Content-Type: application/json
```

```json
{
  "indices": ["events"],
  "query": {
    "query": "*"
  },
  "filters": {
    "type": {
      "type": "TERMS",
      "terms": ["USER_MANAGEMENT"]
    },
    "created": {
      "type": "RANGE",
      "range": {
        "lower": {
          "value": "now-24h",
          "inclusive": true
        }
      }
    }
  },
  "sort": ["-created"]
}
```

### Key fields to customize

| Field | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `indices` | Always `["events"]` for audit data |
| `filters.type.terms` | Event type filter — e.g. `USER_MANAGEMENT`, `ACCESS_REQUEST`, `PROVISIONING`, `AUTH`, `CERTIFICATION`, `ROLE_MANAGEMENT` |
| `filters.created.range` | Time window; use Elasticsearch date-math (`now-24h`, `now-7d`) or ISO-8601 timestamps |
| `sort` | `-created` = newest first |
| `limit` (query param) | Max 250 per page; use `searchAfter` to page past 10,000 results |
| `count=true` (query param) | Adds `X-Total-Count` header to the response |

### Pagination past 10,000 records

Use `searchAfter` with the sort value of the last item in your previous response:

```json
{
  "indices": ["events"],
  "query": { "query": "*" },
  "filters": { ... },
  "sort": ["-created"],
  "searchAfter": ["2026-07-22T10:35:00.000Z"]
}
```

### Rate limits

100 requests per token per 10 seconds. On a `429`, back off using the `Retry-After` response header.

---

```answer-summary
endpoints:
  - method: POST
    path: /oauth/token
    api_version: oauth
  - method: POST
    path: /v3/search
    api_version: v3
auth_flow: OAuth2 client credentials (PAT-based bearer token)
required_scopes: [sp:search:read]
key_parameters: [indices, query, filters, sort, searchAfter, limit, count]
```
